title: Go: Range over Map
description: Write a Go program that iterates over a map using range and prints key-value pairs.
verificationTest: output.includes('USA') && output.includes('Washington DC') && output.includes('Tokyo') && output.includes('Found India: New Delhi') && output.includes('Number of entries: 4')
hints: Use `for key, value := range map { }` to iterate over a map
The comma-ok idiom: `value, ok := map[key]` checks if a key exists
Map iteration order is NOT guaranteed in Go
